create_BLT_model: create a ByteLatentTransformer model from ByteLatentTransformerArgs config with local encoder, global transformer, and local decoder
compute_byte_group_hash: compute rolling polynomial hash embeddings for byte group sequences using byte_group_hash_function
build_cross_attn_mask: build a cross-attention block mask for patch-based encoder or decoder attention using cross_attn_mask
calculate_flops_per_token: calculate the number of FLOPs per token for attention and non-embedding parameters using get_num_flop_per_token
parse_ngram_config: parse a comma-separated ngram to size string into a dictionary mapping ngram lengths to vocab sizes
